ЄСВ

sections.title: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances

rows.label: Duty-free threshold for postal and express parcels to individuals
rows.value: EUR 150 invoice value per consignment: no customs duty or import VAT (excise goods excluded)

rows.label: Parcels above the threshold
rows.value: 10% duty plus 20% VAT on the part above EUR 150, up to EUR 10,000; above that, full declaration at the Customs Tariff rates

rows.label: Import VAT
rows.note: the same rates as on domestic supplies; reduced 7% and 14% for listed goods

source.title: Верховна Рада України, Законодавство України: Податковий кодекс України № 2755-VI, art. 181.1 and 193.1 (редакція від 17.09.2026; read from the Internet Archive capture of 13.10.2026)

rows.label: Duty basis on commercial imports
rows.value: Ad valorem duty on the customs value of the goods (Customs Code art. 279); rates from the Customs Tariff of Ukraine

rows.label: Customs fees
rows.value: No fee for ordinary clearance; a fee set by the Cabinet of Ministers applies only to formalities outside customs premises or working hours (art. 247(8))

rows.label: Travellers: duty-free goods arriving by air
rows.value: Up to EUR 1,000 (excise goods excluded); above it, 10% duty plus VAT on the excess up to EUR 10,000

rows.label: Travellers: duty-free goods arriving by land or sea
rows.value: Up to EUR 500 and 50 kg; allowances apply to one entry a day

rows.label: Travellers: tobacco (18 and over)
rows.value: 200 cigarettes, or 50 cigars, or 250 g of tobacco

rows.label: Travellers: alcohol (18 and over)
rows.value: 5 litres of beer, 2 litres of wine and 1 litre of spirits over 22%

rows.label: Travellers: fuel
rows.value: The vehicle's standard tank plus a portable can of up to 20 litres

rows.label: Cash declaration
rows.value: Written declaration of the full amount for cash and bank metals of EUR 10,000 or more (entry or exit)

rows.value: 18%; 5% or 0% for listed income. Paid by individuals (withheld by employers). Tax Code art. 9.1.2, 167

source.title: Верховна Рада України, Законодавство України: Податковий кодекс України № 2755-VI, art. 167 (редакція від 17.09.2026; read from the Internet Archive capture of 13.10.2026)

rows.value: 5% of income; FOP groups 1, 2 and 4: 10% of the minimum wage a month; group 3: 1%. Paid by individuals and sole proprietors. Tax Code section XX subsection 10 para 16-1

source.title: Верховна Рада України, Законодавство України: Закон № 4015-IX від 10.10.2024 «Про внесення змін до Податкового кодексу України ...» (набрання чинності 01.12.2024); Податковий кодекс України, розділ XX, підрозділ 10, пункт 16-1 (редакція від 17.09.2026); read from Internet Archive captures of 09.10.2026 and 13.10.2026

rows.label: Unified social contribution (єдиний соціальний внесок) [national]
rows.value: 22% (employer); 8.41%, 5.5%, 5.3% for listed employers. Paid by employers, sole proprietors, the self-employed. ЄСВ Law 2464-VI art. 8

source.title: Верховна Рада України, Законодавство України: Закон № 2464-VI «Про збір та облік єдиного внеску на загальнообов'язкове державне соціальне страхування», art. 4, 7, 8 (редакція від 26.01.2026, basis Law 4697-IX; read from the Internet Archive capture of 08.10.2026)

rows.value: 18%; 25% for financial institutions; 50% for banks in 2026; 3% on insurance premiums. Paid by companies. Tax Code art. 136

source.title: Верховна Рада України, Законодавство України: Податковий кодекс України № 2755-VI, art. 136 and section XX subsection 4 para 73 (редакція від 17.09.2026; read from the Internet Archive capture of 13.10.2026)
